headline: Apple unveils OLED iPad mini, but outlets disagree on starting price
summary: Apple revealed an updated iPad mini with a larger OLED display and, per one outlet, its first IP67 water-resistance rating. Most reports put the starting price at $699, but one outlet cited $799, and outlets also differ on whether the new chip is the A20 or the A20 Pro.
